summary: Master the art of Mobile Data Collection and Data Management through our SurveyCTO training. Acquire valuable skills to streamline your data collection process.
lede: Mobile data collection and data management using SurveyCTO helps you turn research requirements into validated digital forms and controlled field workflows. You will work with XLSForm, SurveyCTO, and SurveyCTO Collect to build forms, apply skip logic and constraints, support offline synchronization, manage repeat visits, and maintain accountable submissions. The course takes you from requirements analysis and form testing through deployment, data review, and export management. You will produce a validated data collection form and documented data-quality checklist while learning how to use permissions, case identifiers, audit trails, server data, Excel, CSV exports, and SurveyCTO tools to prepare reliable datasets for analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who design, supervise, administer, validate, or analyze mobile data collection workflows using SurveyCTO. You can join with limited programming experience because the course emphasizes XLSForm configuration, field operations, and data-quality practice rather than software development.
prerequisites: You need basic spreadsheet skills and familiarity with questionnaires, field operations, monitoring, research, or programme data. No prior SurveyCTO experience is required, and you do not need to write code. A laptop is required for the practical XLSForm, SurveyCTO configuration, export, and quality-review exercises. TrainingCred can provide sample datasets and templates for practice, while access to a live SurveyCTO account depends on the delivery arrangement.
